title: Mehndi night near Newington or Wentworth Point? 100% eggless, Harris Park
summary:
Mehndi night near Newington or Wentworth Point, and half the guest list doesn't eat eggs? Order the one cake nobody has to ask about.

Every cake from our Harris Park shop is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not the fondant. Which is why a vegetarian Nani and a cousin with an egg allergy can both take a slice without a quiet word to the host first.

A 10-inch serves 20–22 from $74.99. A 14-inch serves 40–45 from $114.99. Bring a photo of the outfit colours or the mehndi pattern and we work from it. Rasmalai and Mango suit the night well 🎂

Give us 2 days' notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park, open until 10pm, which is late enough for an evening function. Pickup only.

Order on WhatsApp: 0425 697 725. Hindi and Gujarati spoken.
